scope: Binary linear/RBF C-SVC, convex quantile regression and fixed-scale Huber regression; partial JMP method coverage only.

common_contract.shape: Finite nonempty rectangular rows <=10000, <=33 columns and <=1000000 cells. <=16384 argument doubles.
common_contract.work: Nominal n*iterations or n*p*iterations / n*p*p*iterations <=200000000 depending on method. SVM <=512 training rows and <=16 features.
common_contract.error: Malformed, nonfinite, rank-deficient regression and invalid domains return Rust error / adapter SQL NULL. Nonconverged admissible iterates retain explicit convergence:false.
common_contract.stability: Stable first-row origins and mean offsets stored separately; do not reconstruct portable models from rounded display intercepts.

operations.description: Binary soft-margin C-SVC with dual KKT diagnostics: [features...,label0/1]; [n_train,kernel0linear/1RBF=1,C=1,gamma=1/p,tolerance=1e-6,max_iterations=100000].
operations.data: [features...,binary_label]; prefix n_train fits, suffix labels ignored
operations.contract: Minimizes .5||w||^2+C*sum(max(0,1-y*f)) over binary labels represented internally as -1/+1. Dual pair-coordinate SMO preserves 0<=alpha<=C and sum(alpha*y)=0. RBF exp(-gamma*||standardized x-z||^2). Feature population means/scales fitted on training prefix only, with constant features using scale 1. Report exact dual and primal objectives, duality gap, equality/box residuals and KKT up/low gap. KKT working-set bound tolerance is 32*machine_epsilon*C. Convergence requires the final recomputed KKT gap <= requested tolerance. Tie decisions classify as 1.

operations.description: Convex check-loss regression with ADMM residual convergence: [features...,target]; [quantile=.5,rho=1,max_iterations=10000,tolerance=1e-7].
operations.data: [features...,target]; scalar rows fit an intercept only
operations.contract: Unpenalized minimum sum of tau*r for r>=0 and (tau-1)*r otherwise. ADMM splits y=X*beta+r; least-squares beta solve and exact asymmetric soft threshold residual proximal step. Full-rank standardized design and n>parameter count required. Convergence requires both Euclidean primal residual and rho*X-transpose residual-change dual residual below their absolute+relative tolerances. Residual diagnostics are in standardized response/design units; objective is in original response units. Iteration exhaustion returns converged:false and actual residual criteria. Quantile solutions can be nonunique; compare objective and KKT/constraints rather than arbitrary coefficients in that case.

operations.data: [features...,target]; scalar rows fit an intercept only
args: scale: positive fixed response-unit scale; 0 estimates OLS residual MAD once, default 0
operations.contract: Minimizes sum Huber_delta((y-X*beta)/fixed_scale). Optional initial scale is median absolute deviation about median OLS residual / .6744897501960817 and remains fixed through all IRLS iterations. Zero estimated MAD is rejected unless OLS fit is numerically exact; supply positive scale for degenerate residual distributions. Returns residuals, final robust weights, standardized Huber-score norm and fixed-scale HC0 score-sandwich covariance when the inlier derivative information is full rank. standardized_covariance refers to fitted standardized design/response coefficients; coefficient_standard_errors are converted to original slope units. No JMP robust-scale algorithm or inferential equivalence claimed.
